lines:
Project-local SQLite persistence for versioned reusable QA job definitions, links to design specifications and tasks, tags, immutable execution groups, and append-only per-job evidence. Job-definition versions protect overlapping edits; uniquely identified evidence appends do not serialize unrelated runs. Current state is derived from latest evidence plus staleness.

Implemented Markdown extension (2026-09-25; SQLite and text backends): Add markdown to QA designSpecificationLinks and designExternalIds selection semantics, canonical reference validation, title resolution, retrieval and reverse backlinks. Reuse shared target resolution with task links; preserve ordering, job versions, evidence history and existing execution behavior. Title/file-path edits do not break references. Do not delete linked documents or silently unlink QA jobs; require explicit guarded dependency edits. Desktop QA pickers/navigation and backend conversions must preserve these references. Runtime conformance and native/MCP workflows verify that referenced prose is the exact stored specification.

Verification (2026-09-25): Markdown tasks 25-36 implement this extension on the available SQLite and text adapters. Common contracts, actual stdio MCP, native Tauri/WebView2, conversion, independent Git clones and generated-file checks are recorded in task 36, QA jobs 6/7 and docs/markdown-validation.md. Generated files remain derived and agent authoring uses MCP. Server SQL implementation and validation remain pending in storage tasks 20-23.

data.name: QA Store and Run Evidence
